Name: Watermill Expanded
Author: Ex0dus
Description:
[size=4][b]Description:[/b][/size]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40403]yuninocorn's Watermill [/url]is a building that my wife and I love but it always made us a bit sad that we could not use it like a normal mill. My wife also wanted there to be a use for the paper that the watermill produces so we came up with over 20 artisan goods to make out of the 3 types of paper made in yuninocorn's mod![/size]


[size=4][b]Main Features:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]Full mill functionality for the Watermill (rice, wheat, beets, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia items[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26443]Chicken Feed[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39216]Cloths and Colors[/url] fully supported)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Crafting menu recipes added if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25467]Si's Extra Crafting Materials[/url] is installed to convert between the paper in this mod and that mod[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]14 different artisan good recipes made from paper and 1 new machine to process them[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Some items have seasonal or other variants (Giftwrap, Piñatas, Paper Flowers)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]35 new items altogether[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Android compatible (Extra Machine Configs requirement is 1.6.0, which is compatible with Android)[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Future Plans:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]A new machine sprite is being commissioned[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Crossover items with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49743?tab=description]Chocobo Valley Remixed[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Any requested Mill recipes from other mods (as long as I can get permission to do so)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Gift Tastes for items (currently gathering permissions)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Special Orders[/size][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Recipe List:[/size][/b]
[spoiler]Tome - frozen tear, 2 gold bars, 100 paper
Compendium - earth crystal, 2 gold bars, 100 paper
Grimoire - fire quartz 2 gold bars, 100 paper
Recipe Book - iron bar, 5 clay, 100 paper
Giftwrap - 3 clay, 60 paper
Book - 100 paper
Map -squid ink, 25 stone paper
Watercolor Book -copper bar, 15 stone paper
Playing Cards - 10 stone paper
Scrapbook - 5 hardwood, 10 recycled paper
Sketchbook - 15 recycled paper
Piñata - 100 sap, 20 recycled paper
Paper Flower - fiber, 5 recycled paper, any flower
Prismatic Paper Lantern - prismatic shard, 20 recycled paper[/spoiler]
[size=4][b]Variants List:[/b][/size]
[spoiler]Giftwrap -> Make giftwrap in winter
Piñata -> Two variants per season, one in the first half and one in the second half (8 variants total)
Paper Flower -> Day of week (Sunday, Monday, etc.) + even or odd day (14 variants total)[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40403]Farm Building - Watermill[/url][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Installation Instructions:[/size][/b][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Download the Watermill Expanded file in the main files section, then install like normal[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8]

[size=3]Be sure you have [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40403]Farm Building - Watermill[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url] and their requirements installed first, otherwise this mod will do nothing.[/size][/color]
